title: Mass of τ(M, θ, ξ) equals ∫_{M∩W} θ dH^n (Simon 3.2(3))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) a rectifiable triple in U of dimension n (IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ), and T ∈ D_n(U) with T(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n (tauAction n M θ ξ ω) for every ω ∈ D^n(U). Then for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(T) = ∫_{M∩W} θ dH^n in [0, ∞], i.e. T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
